verdict.rationale: AI Gateway issues its own team-owned API keys and lets you set a budget per API key, so a credential handed to an agent can be spend-capped. Usage is also broken down per key. Beyond spend, there is no evidence that a key can be limited to specific models, providers, projects or permissions, or made short-lived. Missing for 10: per-key model/provider/permission scoping, per-agent or expiring key issuance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: AI Gateway API keys belong to a Vercel team and work in local development, CI, external servers, and Vercel deployments.
To cap how much your team, a project, an API key, or a team member can spend, set [budgets]
The Requests section displays summaries by project, API key, and a detailed log of all requests.
